about.detail: Desktop App sharing the dictionary and interface with the Web build. Hybrid Local + Cloud architecture.

webMissing.title: Cannot reach the Web interface
webMissing.explain: Failed to load the interface from {{url}}. Start the Local Runtime with `pnpm --filter @ads-nolimit/api start` (after `pnpm build`) or set ADS_NOLIMIT_WEB_URL to the dev server (http://localhost:5173).
